functionalRequirements.title: Authentication
functionalRequirements.description: Users can register and sign in with email and password.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can register and sign in with email and password.

sourceReferences.quote: Users must register and sign in with email and password.

functionalRequirements.title: Project management
functionalRequirements.description: Project Owners can create and rename projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Project Owners can create and rename projects.

sourceReferences.quote: Project Owners must be able to create and rename projects.

functionalRequirements.title: Task management
functionalRequirements.description: Team Members can create tasks and update task status.
acceptanceCriteria: Team Members can create tasks and update task status.

sourceReferences.quote: Team Members must be able to create tasks and update task status.
Passwords must be stored as salted hashes.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Task list latency
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Load task lists within the stated target.

sourceReferences.quote: Task lists must load within 500 ms for up to 100 tasks.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Failure diagnostics
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Unexpected failures should be logged with sufficient diagnostic context.

sourceReferences.quote: Unexpected failures should be logged with sufficient diagnostic context.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Application readiness
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Health endpoints should allow infrastructure to determine whether the application is running and ready to serve requests.

sourceReferences.quote: Health endpoints should allow infrastructure to determine whether the application is running and ready to serve requests.

constraints.description: Use NestJS and PostgreSQL for the backend.

sourceReferences.quote: The backend must use NestJS and PostgreSQL.

constraints.description: The backend should use Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL and Prisma.

sourceReferences.quote: The backend should use Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL and Prisma.

constraints.description: The frontend should use React and TypeScript.

sourceReferences.quote: The frontend should use React and TypeScript.

constraints.description: The application must support Docker containerization.

sourceReferences.quote: The application must support Docker containerization.

sourceReferences.quote: The invitation expiry duration is unspecified.
